subject: general
question:
Select the option that represents the letters that, when placed from left to right in the same sequence in the blanks below, will complete the letter series.

F G _ C _ I Q _ S F _ S C A I Q _ S F _ S C _ I _ P S
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Given Sequence: F G _ C _ I Q _ S F _ S C A I Q _ S F _ S C _ I _ P S

Now, put the letters in the blank spaces given in the option one by one:

Option 1) SAPGBGAP → F G **__S __**C **__A__** I Q __**P**__ S / F __**G**__ S C A I Q __**B**__ S / F __**G**__ S C __**A**__ I __**P**__ P S

Option 2) SAPGPGAQ → F G __S __C __A__ I Q __P__ S / F __G__ S C A I Q **__P__** S / F __G__ S C __A__ I **__Q__** P S

Here, 'FGSCAIQPS' followed a pattern.

Option 3) SAPGPGBQ → F G __**S**__ C __**A**__ I Q **__P__** S / F __**G**__ S C A I Q __**P**__ S / F __**G**__ S C __**B**__ I __**Q**__ P S

Option 4) SAPFBFAP → F G __**S**__ C __**A**__ I Q __**P**__ S / F __**F**__ S C A I Q __**B**__ S / F __**F**__ S C __**A**__ I __**P**__ P S

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 2**".
